sourceFitAssessment.learnerTask: See how a larger search changes the probability of at least one false rejection under explicit independence.
sourceFitAssessment.gap: No visualization locates the family of tests or separates selected findings from all tests.
sourceFitAssessment.accuracyGuardrails: State the toy independence/null assumptions for family-wise calculations. At least one false rejection, false-discovery rate and probability that an individual finding is false are distinct quantities.
sourceFitAssessment.reasoning: Twenty numbered drawers expose the tested family separately from one reported p=0.03 without assigning a truth label to the drawers. The independent valid/all-null assumptions are explicit. The painted bar fractions agree with 1−0.95^m for m=1,5,20 (5.0%,22.6%,64.2%); Bonferroni 0.05/20=0.0025 remains distinct from that independence calculation. The retained 50-pathway exercise gives 0.001 and rejects using threshold failure as proof of no biological role. Family-wise probability, FDR and an individual finding’s truth probability remain distinct. The larger-search and hidden-family frozen task is fully visualized, without importing a cancer-research false-positive rate.
